verify_without_trusting_us.1_payment_is_real: Open basescan_url. Confirm the USDC transfer, the amount, and that it went to the treasury. This is on Base mainnet and needs nothing from us.
verify_without_trusting_us.2_bytes_are_yours: sha256 the COMMITTED FIELD of the deliverable — the trust envelope's content_sha256 is the hash of the body the SKU produced (content_markdown for research and extract SKUs; the `deliverable` object for the others), NOT of the whole JSON you received. Compare; if they differ, the deliverable was altered.
verify_without_trusting_us.3_binding: settlement_ref on this proof is the SAME tx you just checked, and task_class/ts say what it paid for.
verify_without_trusting_us.what_this_does_NOT_prove: That the work was correct. It proves payment, integrity and linkage — not quality.

signature_disclosure.honest_caveat: proofs emitted before 2026-08-30 17:50 UTC were signed with a DEV key (their signing.dev_key is true) — an integrity check, not a trust anchor. Later proofs are signed with the production key. Either way the on-chain tx is the anchor — verify that instead.
